fields.why: Coverage is measured in each of 4 age groups, 6 urbanicity levels and 4 SVI quartiles.
Age, NCHS urbanicity and SVI (SES) each have 3 or more levels compared. Sex and the dichotomized ACS measures are pairs and do not enter.

Urbanicity and SVI have GEE absolute differences with CIs against a Ref level (per-group vs referent only, resolves_to_finer true). Age coverage is only ranked (highest/lowest) with no test across ages, so it is side by side. The flagged quotes are CSV-row renderings ('Large central metro,56.2,Ref'), not verbatim text; the values they support are right.

brief_issues: Table-label evidence should be quoted as 'group › level' (rule 6); A quoted raw CSV rows, which fail the quote check.
